summary: Frontend-only testing for Chapter 14 NHT walkthrough tab, 3 new NHT quiz questions (Q16-Q18), and regression verification of Ch14 glossary (17 terms) + PE4 Q21 SVG scatter plot. All 13 requested features passed.
critical_code_review_comments: Chapter14CorrelationRegression.jsx: The Quiz 'tab' is actually a button that calls onStartQuiz and navigates away (not a true tab that changes activeTab). This works but is inconsistent with the other 3 tabs. Minor UX note only — doesn't affect functionality.

NHTStep component keeps each step's open state local (useState). This means there's no 'expand/collapse all' control and toggling one doesn't affect siblings — acceptable behaviour and matches the review requirement of being independently collapsible.

chaptersData.js is now ~3090 lines and contains all chapter questions inline. Recommend splitting per-chapter question arrays into /data/questions/chapterXX.js files to reduce cognitive load and merge conflicts.

Glossary items use text-based headings rather than data-testid='glossary-term-*' — adding per-term testids would help future automated testing of glossary content (currently only the '17 terms' badge is reliably targetable).
